title: Call To Action
description: Action control intended for prominent splash or hero calls to action.

url.description: Optional destination URL for navigation-style calls to action.

target.description: Navigation target hint when `url` is provided.

activate.title: Activate
activate.description: Activates the call to action. If a URL is present, this usually maps to the catalog-level `openUrl` intent.

activated.title: Activated
activated.description: Emitted when the call to action is activated by the user.
